audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart is incoherent in three separate ways at a 50.09% win rate. phases[N].side reads 'Skill' on rows 0,1,2,3,5 while win[N] names a champion; phases[4] says Lissandra while win[4] says Akshan; phases[6] says Lissandra while win[6] says Akshan. The content layer also contradicts itself — win[4] gives Akshan level 6 while whys[3] and spikes[1] both call level 6 her strongest window, and win[5] gives Lissandra first item while whys[5] says first item 'does finally tip in your favor'.
audit.why: Every one of those rows renders two answers to the same question. Grounded resolution: Akshan out-ranges Ice Shard 850 to 725 and her only root is 450, so levels 1-2 are his before Glacial Path exists; levels 3 through 6 are hers as the claw comes online and Frozen Tomb lands; first item onward is his, which is what whys[5] and whys[6] already say.

Frozen Tomb at 120s rank 1 is the level 6 spike. Glacial Path at 24s rank 1 is the longest basic cooldown in the lane and the thing worth counting.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page puts the root on Glacial Path (E) in five places — early, spikes[0], whys[1], wants.foe[0], and by implication mid's 'E-Q-R chain'. It also never mentions that self-cast Frozen Tomb makes her untargetable.
audit.why: Ring of Frost (W) is the root: 450 range, 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s. Glacial Path (E) is a claw at 1050 that she re-activates to travel to — it deals damage and moves her, it does not root. Getting this backwards changes the entire spacing rule: the page tells you to fear a root 'from range' when in fact she has to close to 450. And Frozen Tomb self-cast makes her untargetable and invulnerable while healing — which means it can eat a Comeuppance fired at a dying Lissandra. That is the single most expensive unstated interaction in this matchup, since Comeuppance is 100 seconds at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Root moved to Ring of Frost with its 450 range everywhere; Glacial Path written as the travel claw with its 24s cooldown; Frozen Tomb's untargetability and its effect on your R now stated in three fields.
sources: brief enemyKit W/E/R text, ranges, cooldowns and flags (untargetable, heal on R)

notes: Two things here mattered more than the rest. First, the whole page had Lissandra's root on the wrong ability — Glacial Path (E) is a travel claw, Ring of Frost (W) is the 450-range root. That inverts the core spacing rule the page teaches: it tells you to fear a root 'from range' when she actually has to close to 450 to land it. Second, self-cast Frozen Tomb makes her untargetable and invulnerable, which means it can swallow a Comeuppance on a 100-second cooldown — nothing on the page warned about that, and it is the most expensive mistake available in this matchup. It also answers the brief's needs-antiheal flag: the sustain is the R's self-heal, so Grievous Wounds before she Tombs is the counterplay, though I did not have a length-neutral field to write the item timing into. The suspectNames hit ('Her Glacial Path') is a false positive — that is the real ability name.
